name: FEMA Disaster Mind (Disaster Mind Game)
description: This benchmark assesses an AI agent's capacity for calm, effective decision-making under time pressure in simulated natural disasters (blizzard, wildfire, flood). It evaluates stress management, preparedness actions, family/community coordination, and the ability to prevent an emergency from escalating into catastrophe through quick, mindset-driven choices.
reputation: Respected FEMA-backed educational simulation for high-school disaster preparedness training, developed in partnership with iThrive Games
notes: Interactive single-player simulation benchmark focused on agentic capabilities in dynamic, high-stakes environments; low contamination risk due to real-time branching scenarios
